title: Bug Buddies
kdp_subtitle: Cute Bees, Ladybugs, Butterflies and Garden Bugs to Color, with Mazes and Puzzles for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Bees, ladybugs and butterflies are having a party
in the garden, and you are invited!
description:
Meet the cutest bugs in the garden!

Bug Buddies is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Bees, ladybugs, butterflies, snails, caterpillars and frogs
  • Flowers, mushrooms, strawberries and sunny garden scenes
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
Great for nature lovers, spring and summer days, and quiet time.
